slot.brief: A loop moved into or out of a uniform magnetic field region in a given time; compute average induced emf from rate of change of flux.

stem: A 3-turn rectangular coil of sides $20$ cm and $10$ cm, with its plane perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field of $0.5$ T, is moved completely into the field from outside in $0.1$ s. The magnitude of the average induced emf is
working:
$A=(0.20)(0.10)=0.020\ \text{m}^2$ 
$\varepsilon_{\text{avg}}=\dfrac{N B A}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{3(0.5)(0.020)}{0.1}=0.3\ \text{V}$

Independent check: Area = 0.20 × 0.10 = 0.020 m². Average emf = N B A / Δt = (3 × 0.5 × 0.020) / 0.1 = 0.3 V.
